search_control_plane_surface_label: Example State official voter-information search-control-plane policy
delivery_role_note: Search Console property coverage and verified-owner continuity do not become the public rule source, but they do shape whether the office can request recrawl, support host moves, and keep stale search results recoverable during emergencies.

property_scope_set.host_coverage_note: Covers the current primary host and subdomain variants under the official domain.
Used for path-specific inspection and recovery checks on the current public host.
Retained while the legacy or emergency host remains in public circulation or recovery use.

verified_owner_continuity_note: At least two organizationally durable verified-owner paths are maintained so the office does not lose all Search Console control when one token, template, or operator path fails.
verification_method_diversity_note: Verification is not intended to rely on a single brittle mechanism; a secondary verified-owner method is reviewed when the environment changes.
stale_token_retirement_note: Personnel and vendor offboarding include review of underlying verification methods so removed users do not remain re-verifiable through stale tokens.
migration_verification_continuity_note: Host, CMS, and hosting changes include a check that verification files, tags, or DNS methods still work on the new environment before the old environment is retired.
emergency_action_operability_note: The office knows which role can request URL Inspection recrawl, review move support, and inspect coverage on managed URLs during a stale-result or migration incident.
